newsitem.title: USA: MobileMedia may face fines, lose licenses.
newsitem.headline: MobileMedia may face fines, lose licenses.

text.p: MobileMedia Corp on Tuesday said an adverse ruling from the Federal Communications Commission would have a material, adverse effect on its financial condition and results of operations.

The company, which is awaiting an FCC hearing after it voluntarily disclosed filing false information with the agency, said an adverse outcome could result in the loss of its paging licenses, substantial monetary fines or both.

Earlier Tuesday, the FCC ordered a hearing into the company's qualifications to remain a licensee after finding that it filed at least 289 forms apparently misrepresenting that unconstructed paging stations were constructed and providing service to subscribers.
The agency is allowing MobileMedia to continue providing uninterrupted service pending the hearing.
